propositions: Bridge today hard-wired to one project at three points: config scalar, JQL fetcher, outbound applier guard; teams running multiple projects against shared codebase cannot use bridge
Solution models many-to-many as one shared ticket store with project-to-repos mapping in .bridge_state/projects.json, each ticket records its project and repos

Multi-project fetch must iterate all configured projects for base JQL and all three enrichment passes (parent/comment/issuelink maps), merge results by issue, scope per-query truncation per project not globally
Ticket project field is tri-state (absent=legacy, empty=never sync, explicit key=sync there); migration writes zero events and seeds mapping from backend.project via idempotent ensure unit
Store with >1 project carries multi-project-bridge capability stamp in required_capabilities; older binaries fail closed on multi-project stores while single-project stores remain writable
Outbound dispatch relaxes cross-project guard from single configured project to set membership; ticket with explicit project targets it rather than repo default
